Figure 2:Detailed pipeline of SplatLab.Expanding the overview in Figure1, a research intent (or no input) passes through six stages (grounding, Elo-pre-ranked ideation,EVOLVE-BLOCKimplementation, cascade-weighted Elo refinement across eight islands, integrity audit, and reviewer-driven manuscript synthesis) run by a three-level hierarchy of Professor,
PhD Coordinators, and Undergrad Leaf Agents.

Figure 3:Qualitative comparison against per-regime SOTA.Columns: ground truth with evaluated region boxed (GT), zoomed crop (GT-Crop), the leading published 3DGS method for that row’s regime (SOTA, varies per row; see Tab.1), and the SplatLab-discovered method (Ours).
Figure 4:Generated papers accepted at a CVPR 2026 workshop.(a)AttDis & Friends, (b)NeedleSwap, and (c)AuditSplat, all accepted as posters. Each row shows pages 1–8 from left to right.
